prompt: 我的 myapp 專案 Pod 一直 CrashLoopBackOff，我想看 log 然後進去 pod 裡面看看發生什麼事。我現在在 kde workspace 目錄下，當前環境是 dev-env。請告訴我要用哪些 kde 指令，並直接執行。

assertions.text: Uses `kde proj tail myapp` (or equivalent) to check logs
Uses `kde proj pod myapp` to list pods
Uses `kde proj pod-exec myapp` or `kde proj exec myapp` to enter the container/pod
Mentions `kde k9s` as an option for visual debugging
Does NOT suggest irrelevant commands or confuse kde commands with raw kubectl
